origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 快 (quick) as the sound. 快 replaced the old word 箸 (chopsticks), which sounded like 住 (to stop), a bad word for boatmen.

裸.def: bare, nude; to strip, to undress

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 果 (fruit) as the sound: being without clothes, naked, bare.

裸.name: naked

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 咸 (all) as the sound: a salty mineral, alkali. It replaces the older 鹼, built from 鹵 (salt) with a different sound part.

熄.def: to extinguish, to put out, to quench

ety.hint: To end 息 a flame 火; 息 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 息 (breath, rest) as the sound and sense: a fire coming to rest, to put out.

熄.name: put out

嘘.def: to blow, to exhale, to hiss, to sigh; to praise

凸.def: to protrude, to bulge out; convex

origin.says: A picture of a shape with a bump sticking up: convex. The opposite of 凹 (concave).

凸.name: bulge

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 解 (to untie) as the sound: a mind that has come loose, slack and idle.

ety.hint: A open mouth 口, waiting for fruit to fall from the tree 木

origin.says: 木 (tree) plus 口 (mouth): a tree with tasty fruit, the apricot. The oldest dictionary saw a shortened 可 (can) as the sound, which is unlikely.

浆.def: pulp, starch, syrup; a thick fluid

origin.says: Simplified from 漿: 水 (water, liquid) for the meaning plus 將 (to lead) as the sound, cut to its simplified top ⺦ + 夕: a thick drink, pulp or paste.

浆.name: thick liquid

ety.hint: A legendary beast 离 captured by a man 人

origin.says: First a drawing of a hunting net, meaning to capture; 今 (now) was added as the sound. Borrowed for birds and game, while 擒 (capture) took the old sense. The parts have since blurred into 人 (person) over 离 (leave).
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 刁 (sly) as the sound: to hold something in the mouth.

辰.def: early morning; fortune, good luck; 5th terrestrial branch

origin.says: Draws a farming tool for weeding, perhaps made of a big clam shell; another reading sees a person clinging to a cliff. It was borrowed for the fifth earthly branch and for times of day.

辰.name: clam hoe

origin.says: Simplified from 紋: 糸 (thread) for the meaning plus 文 (pattern) as sound and meaning: lines of thread, stripes, a pattern, wrinkles.

ety.hint: A fence 册 made of wood 木; 册 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (wood) plus 冊 (strips bound in a row), which gives sound and meaning: a fence of wooden stakes, a grid.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: food chewed in the mouth, to feed young ones.
Simplified from 橢: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 隋 (a dynasty name) as the sound, first an oblong wooden vessel, now an oval. As in 堕 (to fall), 隋 lost its 工 and became 陏.
衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: coarse woollen cloth of poor people, and its dull brown colour.

蹦.def: to jump, to bounce on; bright

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 崩 (collapse) as the sound: to jump, to bounce.

蹦.name: bounce

ety.hint: Swirling 旋 water 氵; 旋 also provides the pronunciation

浸.def: to dip, to immerse, to soak; to percolate, to steep

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus an old sound part (a hand with a broom under a roof) shortened to the right side: to soak in water.

浸.name: soak

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 丈 (ten feet) as the sound: a wooden stick, a walking cane.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 王 (king) as the sound: a crooked tree, hence bent, wronged, in vain.
Simplified from 鷹: 䧹 (a falcon held by a person under a roof) as the sound plus 鳥 (bird) for the meaning: eagle, hawk. Only 鳥 became 鸟.

沃.def: to water, to irrigate; fertile, rich

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 夭 (young, bending) as the sound: to pour water on land, to irrigate; well-watered land is fertile.

沃.name: watered field

勘.def: to investigate; to survey, to explore; to compare; to collate

origin.says: 甚 (very) as the sound plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: to look into something hard, to survey and check.

勘.name: survey

嗜.def: addicted to, fond of, with a weakness for

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 耆 (elderly) as the sound: a taste the mouth keeps coming back to, a craving.

嗜.name: addiction

origin.says: 鱼 (fish) for the meaning plus 里 (village) as the sound: the carp. Simplified from 鯉, 魚 shortened to 鱼.

嚣.def: to make noise; to treat with contempt

origin.says: Four 口 (mouth) around 页 (head): a person surrounded by clamouring mouths, hence noisy uproar. Simplified from 囂 only by writing 頁 (head) as 页.

嚣.name: clamour

粽.def: a dumpling made of glutinous rice

薇.def: a kind of fern; Osmunda regalis

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 微 (tiny) as the sound: a kind of edible fern.

薇.name: fern

origin.says: 艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: a plant name, the plantain or banana.

斧.def: axe, hatchet; to chop, to hew

origin.says: 父 (father, once a hand with an axe) as the sound plus 斤 (axe) for the meaning: the axe.

斧.name: hatchet

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 呈 (present) as the sound: to give free rein, to show off.
冖 (cover) over 兔 (rabbit): a rabbit caught under a net, unable to run, hence a wrong suffered, an injustice.

嵌.def: valley, ravine; to fall into; to inlay, to set in

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus a shortened 歁 as the sound: a deep gorge, a gap in the rock; then to set something into a gap, to inlay.

嵌.name: inlay

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 徹 (go through) shortened to its right side as the sound: water you can see through, clear.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 需 (need) as the sound: a soft, weak heart, timid.

镶.def: inset, inlay; to set, to mount; to fill

origin.says: From 鑲: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 襄 (assist) as the sound, setting something into metal, to inlay. The simplified form uses the short metal sign 钅.

镶.name: set in metal

ety.hint: To search for something with eyes 见 and hands 爫

origin.says: 爫 (hand) over 见 (see): searching with hand and eye. Simplified from 覓 (見 → 见).
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: moss, a low plant.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 㸒 (to approach) as the sound: to soak, overflow, hence excessive and then licentious.

蒂.def: root cause; the stem of a fruit; the peduncle of a flower

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 帝 (emperor) as the sound: the stalk where a fruit or flower joins the stem; 帝 itself was first this word.

蒂.name: fruit stalk

origin.says: 革 (leather) for the meaning plus 安 (secure) as the sound and hint: the leather seat that sits you securely on a horse.

惮.def: to fear, to dread; to dislike, to avoid

阂.def: separated, blocked; to prevent, to block

ety.hint: people living out of the way

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: a person living out of the way, remote.

爽.def: crisp, refreshing; candid, frank; pleased, happy

ety.hint: A person 大 breathing lots of fresh air 爻

origin.says: 大 (a person) with 㸚 (crossed marks, light through a lattice) on both sides: bright and clear, hence crisp, refreshing, frank. The exact picture is disputed.

爽.name: refreshing

origin.says: A picture of a fork in a branch or a path.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 告 (tell) as the sound: vast, flooding water, hence great and grand.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 久 as the sound: burning herbs on the skin as a cure, moxibustion.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 戋 (small) as the sound: a wooden pen or shed, then a warehouse or inn. Simplified from 棧.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 坴 (clod of earth) as the sound: friendly eyes, amiable, at peace.

辍.def: to suspend, to stop, to halt

搓.def: to rub or roll between the hands

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 差 (difference, once 'to rub') as sound and meaning: to rub or roll between the hands.

搓.name: rub

谱.def: chart, list, table; spectrum; musical score

origin.says: Simplified from 譜: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 普 (universal) as the sound: a written record in order, a chart, a musical score; 言 became 讠.

谱.name: musical score

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 戊 (axe, fifth stem) as the sound: plants growing thick and lush.

苍.def: dark blue; deep green; old, hoary

origin.says: Simplified from 蒼: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 倉 (granary) as the sound, now 仓: the deep green of grass, dark blue, grey-haired.

苍.name: deep green

ety.hint: A scarf 巾 used to maintain a girl's purity 巾

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: a piece of cloth worn or carried, a kerchief or wrap.

掐.def: to hold, to choke; to gather in one hand

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 臽 (pit) as the sound, perhaps also its meaning: to dig the fingernails in, to pinch.

掐.name: nip

俯.def: to bow down, to face down, to look down

origin.says: 府 (mansion) as the sound plus a bending person for the meaning: 'to bow down'. In bronze inscriptions the person was 勹 (person bending over), which later became 亻 (person).

俯.name: stoop

origin.says: 包 (wrap) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: a blade tool, the carpenter's plane.

ety.hint: A flat 枼 stone 石

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 枼 (thin leaf) as the sound and the hint of something flat and thin: a small flat dish.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: to whistle; a whistle, a sentry post.
Simplified from 啞: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 亞 (second) as the sound, now 亚: mute, hoarse.

ety.hint: When the sun is a foot 尺 above the horizon 旦

origin.says: From 晝: 聿 (hand with a brush) over 日 (sun) with a line below, daytime; the role of 聿 is unclear, perhaps the sound. The simplified form writes 聿 in cursive as 尺 (foot ruler) over 旦 (dawn).

ety.hint: An older 老 woman 女; 老 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 女 (woman) plus 老 (old), which is also the sound: an old woman, a grandmother on the mother's side.
Simplified from 槳: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 將 (to lead) as the sound, cut to its simplified top ⺦ + 夕: a wooden oar.
